djzc777.dialog.root.title: Winter War Recruit Training
djzc777.dialog.root.body1: Learn objectives, launchers, the field manual, and class equipment through a guided run, then test your kit at the practice range.
djzc777.dialog.root.body2: Return here from the pause menu or with /function djzc777:open. You can replay the tutorial from the Winter War Encyclopedia.
djzc777.dialog.root.body3: Choose the entry below to restart recruit training. Advanced modules are still being designed.
djzc777.dialog.root.body4: Follow the beacon. Every step on the battlefield teaches you something new. %1$s
djzc777.dialog.tutorial_skip.title: Recruit Check-in · Skip the Tutorial?
djzc777.dialog.tutorial_skip.body1: The guided tutorial teaches objective capture, launcher activation, and your equipment at a practice range. You will train from the T side.
djzc777.dialog.tutorial_skip.body2: Already know Winter War? Skip the tutorial to choose a team and head straight to the loadout area.
djzc777.dialog.tutorial_a.title: Training Objective · Capture Point A
djzc777.dialog.tutorial_a.body1: Winter War is about capturing objectives. Enter Point A's ground marker to advance the T-side capture progress. Hold control until the 60-second progress is complete to take Point A.
djzc777.dialog.tutorial_a.body2: Capturing is about entering and controlling an area, not defeating a single target. Finish Point A, then find the next objective.
djzc777.dialog.tutorial_b.title: Training Objective · Find Point B
djzc777.dialog.tutorial_b.body1: Watch for three clues when locating an objective: beacon beams in the distance, floating labels near each point, and locator-bar icons during launcher stages.
djzc777.dialog.tutorial_b.body2: Point B is ahead to your left or right. Turn your view to find its beacon, then move toward it. The locator bar tracks launchers; it does not point to ordinary objectives.
djzc777.dialog.tutorial_c.title: Well Done · Launcher Activated
djzc777.dialog.tutorial_c.body1: You activated a launcher! Interact with the item frame to rotate its item. Each launcher takes 7 full rotations; activate them all before attacking the linked objective.
djzc777.dialog.tutorial_c.body2: Check the locator bar: its icon shows the launcher's direction. Read the battlefield data before you move; that is modern warfare's information link.
djzc777.dialog.tutorial_win.title: Training Complete · Victory
djzc777.dialog.tutorial_win.body1: Excellent! You captured Point D and won your first battle. You can now locate objectives, activate launchers, and push the frontline.
djzc777.dialog.tutorial_win.body2: Next, visit the practice loadout area and firing range to learn the field manual and try a class for yourself.
djzc777.dialog.tutorial_gui1.title: Winter War Field Manual · Row One
djzc777.dialog.tutorial_gui1.body1: Join CT or T to choose the defending or attacking side; Class Selection changes your class and equipment.
djzc777.dialog.tutorial_gui1.body2: The next prompt opens the real class menu, where you can pick a class and try its weapons.
djzc777.dialog.tutorial_gui2.title: Winter War Field Manual · Row Two
djzc777.dialog.tutorial_gui2.body1: The radio sends battlefield calls to teammates; Redeploy returns you to deployment; Stop Music only affects your own audio.
djzc777.dialog.tutorial_gui2.body2: These controls handle communication, returning to deployment, and personal audio. They do not change your team's objective.
djzc777.dialog.tutorial_gui3.title: Winter War Field Manual · Row Three
djzc777.dialog.tutorial_gui3.body1: Ready confirms your pre-match equipment check; Cancel Ready withdraws it. A match starts only when everyone is ready.
djzc777.dialog.tutorial_gui3.body2: Open Class Selection, choose a kit, and test its weapons at the range. Leave through the clearly marked exit when you are ready to finish basic training.
djzc777.dialog.tutorial_choose.title: Choose Your Class
djzc777.dialog.tutorial_choose.body1: Open the class system below. After choosing your equipment, test it at the range, then walk to the visible exit when you are done.
djzc777.dialog.tutorial_end.title: Basic Training Complete · What's Next?
djzc777.dialog.tutorial_end.body1: That concludes basic training. You can replay the recruit tutorial from the Winter War Encyclopedia at any time.
djzc777.dialog.tutorial_end.body2: Would you like to continue with advanced training? It will be organized into modules; the module list is still being designed.
djzc777.dialog.tutorial_advanced.title: Advanced Training · Modules Coming Later
djzc777.dialog.tutorial_advanced.body1: Advanced training is being planned as a set of focused modules. This page reserves the entry point; return here when the modules are ready.
djzc777.tutorial.start.denied: A match is in progress. Recruit training is unavailable right now.
djzc777.tutorial.end.no_team: Choose a team before finishing recruit training.
